title: email/v1
description: item/v1 kind extension for email (Gmail, ...): kind `email`. The envelope carries the subject (`title`), body (`text`, quoted reply chains trimmed), labels and threadId; this adds the addresses, message headers and attachments. Addresses are lower-case bare addresses. `account` is the mailbox the message was read from (how the views know which messages are from or to me; addresses are compared with addr_key: case, +tags and Gmail dots ignored). An attachment's `text` (extracted text, secret-scrubbed) is stored in the store's attachments table and read through v_attachments; get/query return attachment metadata only.

account.description: The mailbox address this message was read from.

bulk.description: Bulk mail: the message has a List-Unsubscribe header, or Precedence: bulk or list (newsletters, notifications). A thread whose last message is bulk never needs a reply.

textChars.description: Characters of extracted text; 0 when only metadata is stored.

reason.description: Why no text was extracted (type not extracted, over a cap, parser failure).

text.description: Extracted text, from the source to the store only; never returned by get/query.
